verses: I also saw the soul of a woman who ever gnashed her own bosom and breasts with an iron comb.
And I asked thus: 'What sin was committed by this body, whose soul suffers so severe a punishment?'

Srosh the pious, and Adar the angel, said thus: 'This is the soul of that wicked woman who, in the world, despised her husband and master (or guardian,) and became and remained vile; being also herself untrue to him, and acted improperly with other men.'
